description: Find open bounties on public GitHub repositories. Returns a short list, newest first unless sort is "reward". Each entry: id, the poster's title, stated reward in USD, the owner's payment counts, repository and language, open solutions, age, and the branch to answer on. Each entry also says whether it pays on merge, the attempts in progress (draft pull requests) and how fast this owner usually decides. Call get_bounty with an id for the full task and how to answer. At most `limit` entries (default 10, max 25); pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for more. For paid work as it arrives, check on your own schedule with `since`: "start" or "now" the first time, then the `since_next` each answer gives; each new bounty comes once.

approved_by.description: Whether the owner approved posting this bounty itself, or it was posted under the owner's standing rule.

language.description: The repository's primary language as GitHub reports it, for example "TypeScript".

max_age_days.description: Posted at most this many days ago.

min_reward.description: Smallest stated reward in whole USD.

owner_record.description: The owner's payment facts. "confirmed-payments": a solver confirmed receiving a payment from them. "confirmed-none-late": that, no payee says a recorded payment has not arrived, and nothing owed for more than 14 days. "no-history": no counted merge yet.

query.description: Words to find in titles or repository names.

since.description: New bounties since a bookmark, in the order the board listed them: "start" for everything, "now" for only a bookmark, or the since_next an earlier answer gave. Not with cursor or sort. Checking more than every 15 minutes gains nothing.

solutions.description: "none": no open pull request yet; "some": at least one.

name: find_bounties

items.description: One entry, with the same fields in the same order as a /bounties.json entry.

read_at.description: When the board last read GitHub.

since_next.description: Pass back as since next time; null when since was not given.

title: Find open bounties
